text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Singapore's Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong urged the world's trade ministers to move forward to liberalise trade and make the first World Trade Organisation (WTO) ministerial conference a success.
- Singapore office rentals expected to drop in 1997, say analysts.
- Singapore Technologies Electronic and Engineering acquires Singapore $58.6 million of electronic system assets in restructuring exercise.
- Singapore share trading value hits Singapore $6.4 billion in November.
- Trade leaders from 127 countires began wrangling on range of issues at first WTO conference in Singapore.
- Asian stock markets saw some recovery on Monday after last Friday's plunge on U.S. Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's remarks.
- Singapore Telecom's monopoly may end sooner as Singapore made improved offers to further liberalise telecommunications during a side meeting at the WTO conference on Monday.
- Allied Irish Bank to merge two of its fund management units.
